rules: Collect and process only for missing-person resolution, family-link restoration, disaster response and auditability.
Public publication must be necessary for a defined humanitarian purpose and use the minimum fields required.
Family-supplied contact details are withheld unless explicit publication consent is documented.
Sensitive health, identity-document and exact-address data are never included in public interoperability exports.
A source publishing personal data does not automatically authorise republication of all fields.
Death or consequential identity conclusions require human review and are never created by interoperability export logic.
Withdrawal or correction requests do not erase immutable source evidence; they change publication/access state while preserving the audit trail.
